data.title: Drain or re-route in-flight local streams at mode-switch restart

data.author: implement
data.comment: Design decision (AC2): chose the BOUNDED-DRAIN option over pre-emptive remote re-route (re-route is only feasible pre-content via the existing StreamingPreContentError fallback; mid-generation streams cannot be silently spliced). Bounded drain: set_mode arms drain synchronously; new chat requests get a short 503 + Retry-After while draining; _spawn_restart delays the kill until in-flight local streams finish, bounded by server.mode_switch_drain.max_seconds (default 30). Flagging per parent constraint: this re-introduces a SHORT, configurable drain window (LP-0MSF9RUSQ007M346 removed the minutes-long slot-transition drain; mode-switch transitions previously had none). The 'no long rejection window' property is preserved: drain is self-expiring (deadline), gate requires restart_pending AND draining (inert otherwise), enabled:false / max_seconds:0 restores 'just restart'. Slot-schedule transitions are untouched.
